title: Compound
description: The thing with a physiological effect and a dose. Distinct from an ingredient (a delivery vehicle) and a product (a SKU). Upper limits deliberately live in reference/nutrient-requirements.json (L0), not here — a UL is a sourced reference value, not a property of the molecule.

aliases.description: Label synonyms, used when parsing existingSupplementUse free text and product labels.

conversions.description: Multipliers to this compound's canonical unit, e.g. vitamin D3 IU -> mcg is 0.025.

members.description: Present only on GROUP compounds (e.g. epa-dha, bcaa). A group's amount is the sum of its members. Dosing targets and upper limits may reference a group; products may declare either the group or its members.

strainSpecific.description: True for probiotic strains, where 'the category' is not a valid unit of recommendation. Forces product-level rather than ingredient-level reasoning.
